rows.en: Stay quiet and watch him for a while

"...Um.
What exactly are you playing at?"
"Hm, what's that?
Why would you say a thing like that?"{p}

"Um.
...Could you, uh, tell us a little more about the statue?"{p}

Kazama looked away from {f:me|me}, made a troubled face, and swept his hair back.
"...Fine.
As long as you won't regret it.
If you swear right here and now that you'll never regret it, I'll tell you."
.........
He {f:seemed|seemed} to be trying to avoid getting to the real point.
Did he know a story that terrifying{f:?|?}{p}Should I really hear any more of this{f:?|...?}
Say I won't regret it, so tell me
Back out, since I might regret it

"Kazama, please tell me.
I don't care how frightening the story is.
{f:I|I} may be a lowly one, but I'm a member of the newspaper club.
I can't abandon an interview halfway."{p}

Kazama stared at {f:me|me} as if his gaze could pierce my eyes.
"If you're that determined..."
His eyes were colored with firm resolve.
What kind of terrifying story {f:was|was} about to be told?
Had the statue that walks on its own at night caused some unimaginable incident{f:?|...?}{p}

The club room was so quiet it seemed you could hear each person's heartbeat.
Hot...
It was so {f:hot|hot}.
Streak after streak of sweat ran between my shirt and my skin.
After a long silence, Kazama lowered his eyes and began to tell the story of the statue.{p}
Ask if that's really the end
Move on to the next person's story

"Um..."
"{f:What's with you|Hmm~}?
{f:I told it to you in detail, didn't I|What's the matter}?
{f:Everything from where the statue is to what it looks like.|Were you amazed at how detailed it was?}
{f:If you're a lowly newspaper club member yourself|Did you get the idea of}{f:, you know how hard I worked to tell that story, right| recruiting me into the newspaper club}?
This {f:meticulous|precise} description.
Quite a documentary, wasn't it?
{f:Could a lowly thing like you|Oh}{f: tell a story like that|, save the autographs for later, okay}?{p}
Why did Hino invite someone like this?
Ponder why he was ever born into this world
Ponder his life, love and death
Think: "Nozomu Kazama... what a lovely name"

Why did Hino invite someone like this{f:?|?}
What on earth {f:is with|is with} this guy{f:?|?}{p}

………………………………………………………………Kazama started scratching his belly, scritch-scratch.
"H-hey, what do you think you're doing?!★"
{f:I|I} hurriedly stopped him.
Rolling up his shirt so openly like that...
{f:And with girls in the room, too|Ugh, gross}...{p}

"{f:Sorry, sorry|Whoops}.
{f:I farted|Do you smell something}."
K-Kazama...
A horribly dangerous scent was drifting from his raised rear.
………………………………………{p}

The club room was engulfed in foul air.
Agony.
To think that treatment this cruel could exist in this world.
Now that I've known this agony, I can overcome any hardship the rest of my life may bring. So {f:I|I} believe.
{f:It's no good|It's no good}, I'm about to {f:pass out|pass out}...
Ah.
Ahh.
Ahhh......{p}

"...I'm sorry.
I think I'll pass after all.
I have a bad feeling about it."
I couldn't listen to any more of this story.{p}

Why was this person ever born into this world{f:?|?}
{f:I|I} don't know.
Surely the Tanakas who live next door to {f:me|me} don't know either.
Nor does Pochi, the dog my relatives keep.
.........
What is all this?
Why {f:do I|do I} {f:have to|have to} think about this?
Forget it, I'll hear the next person's story.{p}

"Well then, the next person..."
"Hold {f:on|on} a sec.
My story isn't over yet."
Kazama started {f:complaining|saying that}.
"But you just said, 'The statue moves on its own at night... The end'!"
"{f:Quit nagging|Now, just listen}.
{f:I'm saying I'll tell you a bit more|I've gotten the urge to tell a bit more}{f:, so quit resisting|, okay}.
I just thought up a new documentary{f:, see|}."
"Kazama, a documentary isn't something you just 'think up'..."
"The principal's statue which was erected on March 14, 1990 is made of bronze and its surface is polished to a gleaming shine and moreover it is smooth and firm so that you feel the breath of life in it as if it were alive and furthermore......mutter mutter mutter......"
Kazama was muttering away.
{f:I|I} left him to it and decided to go on to the next story.
"Well then, let's go on to the next story.
Next person, please..."{p}

Nozomu Kazama... what a lovely name.
.........
{f:Since|Because} this guy was so completely absurd, even {f:I|I} started thinking nonsense.
This is no good{f:.|.}
At this rate, the interview will be ruined.
The principal's statue moves on its own at night.
...Is that {f:true|true}?
I'll jot it down just in case{f:,|,} but there's no point in talking with this guy any further{f:.|.}
"{f:Hey, Mr. Lowly.|I'm so glad I met you.}
{f:Come on|Hey}, {f:move on to the next story already.|isn't that right, baby?}"
.........
Holding back the anger welling up inside, {f:I|I} decided to hear the next story.
"Well then, the next story, please.
Next is......"{p}
"Well then, who's next..."{p}

As {f:I|I} began to say that, Kazama lifted his chin and {f:shot me a quick, contemptuous look|knitted his brows}.
"Oh, moving on to the next person's story?
{f:You're hopeless|What a shame}.
And here I was, about to tell you a truly scary story."
Hmph...
What {f:is|is} with this guy?
"...Kazama.
You said 'the end' at the end of your story just now, didn't you?"{p}

"{f:Look here|Heh heh}, {f:with an interview|you see, with an interview}, the key is how well you draw out the other person's story.
You can't just {f:sit there in a daze and |}listen to what they tell you.
{f:Don't you understand even|Sorry, was}{f: that much| that a bit harsh}?
...{f:Well|But}, {f:whatever|I'm not angry or anything, okay}.
{f:If you don't want to hear it|If it's all right with you}, {f:that's fine by me|I'll tell you some other time}."
...Grrr.
While {f:I|I} was at a loss, Kazama began urging everyone to get on with the next story.
"My story ends here.
{c}{f:|} said that's enough, after all.
So, whose turn is it next?"{p}

The food at that cafeteria... is awful.
The awful story. The end.
………………………………………………………………
I-I wish I hadn't listened.
"That cafeteria really is awful, isn't it?{p}

"...I feel like this gathering is cursed by something.
Let's stop for today.
I'm terribly sorry, but could we continue this some other time?"
When I said that, everyone hurried out of the club room.{p}

Lo and behold, Kazama... popped out from under a desk.
"Hahaha, I only hid for a second.
What a bunch of scaredy-cats."
With that, Kazama looked at me with a big grin.
"And you, {a}. Honestly, {a}.
You're in the newspaper club, so what are you doing getting spooked by a little thing like this?"
...K-Kazama...!
If I'd looked carefully, I should have seen he was under the desk...
The others and I had let fear get the better of us, and we weren't paying attention.
Ah, I fell for Kazama's prank and ruined our seven wonders interview☆{p}

I was beaten.
Truly beaten...
Then and there, I resolved to put a line like this in the feature article on the school's seven wonders:
"Let me tell you of the greatest of this school's seven wonders: the story of a terrifying human being.
At this school there is a terrifyingly flippant guy named Nozomu Kazama.
The end."
………………………………………………………………
I'd made up my mind, but somehow it felt hollow...{p}

"Well then, I'd like to move on to the next story.
So, for the third one..."
Trying to rescue the mood, which had gone completely flat, {f:I|I} made an effort to respond calmly.
The best thing to do with people like this is ignore them{f:.|.}
Then Kazama, perhaps angry at being ignored, turned a look of protest toward {f:me|me}.
"{f:Just as I thought|That's so mean}, {f:you don't take being a reporter seriously enough|you've hurt me}.
{f:I'm disappointed in you|I'm so sad I can't stand it}."{p}

Then he shrugged theatrically and sighed.
"{f:I'd heard you were a capable newcomer|And here I'd been looking forward to this day}{f:, so I had high hopes for you...|...}"
Ah, there he goes again, trying to get attention...
Oh well, I guess I'll {f:humor him|have to humor him}.
"Kazama, is there something you forgot to tell us...?"{p}
"W-well, that's true, but..."

"{c}{f:|}... you see, it pains me, {f:how utterly hopeless your attitude is|the way you go about} when you listen to a story.
A moment ago, you tried to wrap up my story in a single line.
You're a member of the newspaper club, aren't you?
{f:If you can't express|You could have shown} at least the feeling of 'Thank you for that wonderful story'{f:, what good are you|, couldn't you}?
{f:Unless you're more sensitive|I think that way}{f:, you'll never make it big.| we'd both feel good.}"
...{f:Oh|Oh}, so in the end he's just saying I didn't thank him enough{f:.|.}
Normally, I don't think that's the sort of thing you go demanding...
It can't be helped{f:.|.}
"Why, thank you so very much for that truly wonderful story.
And not only that, I'm truly delighted that you even gave me such wonderful advice."
...Ugh, he really is an exhausting person{f:.|.}{p}

"No, as long as you understand.
It's all for your sake.
You should cultivate your sensitivity by looking at things that are beautiful and noble.
...I know, I'll give you something nice."{p}

Kazama was looking at {f:me|me} with a smile at the corner of his mouth.
I'm done getting involved with this person.
"Look how much I'm looking out for you.
Don't you think there's no man as wonderful as me?"
...Yes, yes.
Go ahead and talk to yourself all you like.
Time to pull myself together and move on{f:.|, I guess.}
"Well then, the next story, please."{p}

"All right, then, I'll tell you my very best story."
Wait, that's Kazama{f:!|!}
"No, Kazama, your story's already over!"
"Do you really think my story ended with just that?
If so, you're making a terrible mistake."
Kazama had an awfully serious look on his face.
"I wash my hands of this.
The important part was just about to start...
It's too late now, no matter how much you regret it."
"Wait a minute.
Then why did you say 'the end'?!★"{p}

"They say every end is a new beginning, right?
{f:If you couldn't even notice that|I wanted you to notice that}, {f:maybe you're just not cut out to be a reporter|understand}?
{f:I don't sense a shred of talent in you|I was testing you}.
In the first place, a reporter is......"
"Leave me alone!"
That was close, that was close.
I'd almost gotten swept up in his pace again{f:.|.}
Honestly, I can't tell whether his logic holds together or not...
Hanging around with Kazama any longer would be a waste of time{f:.|.}
"{f:Anyway|So anyway}..., your......rather than..."
Kazama was still babbling about something.
Argh, I'm ignoring him, period{f:!|!}
Ignore☆
"Well then, next person.
Please, give us an amazing story to cleanse our palates."{p}
Wait. I have a bad feeling about this
Listen in silence

"Um, could you wait a moment?"
"...Hm?
What's wrong?
Let's see, do you want to hear this story with just the two of us?"
"That's not it...
Um, Kazama, your story isn't something like 'the cafeteria food is awful'... is it?"
"...Oh, so you knew too.
That's right.
That cafeteria's awful, isn't it?{p}
